mapper.sql: SELECT v.change_version_id, r.history_id, r.record_id, v.version_no, v.operation_type, v.snapshot_format, v.snapshot_json, v.create_by, v.create_time, c.client_id, c.party_id, c.client_no, original.create_by applicant_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_client_application a WHERE a.client_id=c.client_id AND a.requested_by_account_id=original.create_by) application_count FROM t_business_change_version v JOIN t_business_change_record r ON r.history_id=v.history_id AND r.record_type='CLIENT' AND r.aggregate_root_type='CLIENT' AND r.record_id=r.aggregate_root_id AND r.parent_history_id IS NULL JOIN t_client c ON CAST(c.client_id AS CHAR)=r.record_id JOIN t_business_change_version original ON original.history_id=r.history_id AND original.version_no=1 AND original.operation_type='CREATE' WHERE v.operation_type IN ('CREATE','UPDATE') AND v.version_no <= r.current_version
mapper.update: UPDATE t_business_change_record SET current_version=#{row.sourceVersion}, update_time=#{row.occurredAt} WHERE history_id=#{row.historyId} AND current_version=#{row.sourceVersion} - 1
